title: mixed values en dash
rule: When the field represents multiple non-identical values, show an en dash (–), not a blank or a single value.
pass_when: Mixed non-identical values display an en dash (–).
fail_when: Mixed values shown as blank or as one of the values.
overview: Mixed non-identical field values show an en dash, not a blank or single pick.
apply_when: Multi-select or bulk-edit fields holding different values across items.
not_when: Single-value fields, identical values across items, or empty never-set fields.
agent_hint: Show an en dash for mixed values; never blank the field or pick one value.
description: When a field represents several non-identical values at once, the control must signal that mix clearly. Spectrum requires an en dash (–) instead of leaving the field blank or displaying one of the underlying values as if it were shared. Blank looks unset; a single value looks like consensus. Use this on bulk-edit and multi-item forms where the selection set differs; do not invent a house glyph or collapse the mix into one chosen option.
do_not_claim: A hyphen/minus as equivalent; bulk-edit architecture.
